race.comment: Tough race complicated by wide draws for many of the chances. YARRAWIZARDHARRY (3) has the coveted rails though and looks hard to beat. Racing well in richer races lately but off the inside here looks likely to take catching. ROYAL FOX (4) is racing well and deserves a win. Placed last two, the latest runner-up and beaten less than a length at Murray Bridge. Gets chance. TAUPO TIGER (9) has drawn wide and flashed home at last two starts. Even wider gate this time but will relish the good pace and be charging late. TOUR DE MOON (5) is better than last time and looks hard to hold out. HAMNER SPRINGS (8) is on the quick back-up after finishing seventh in town on the weekend. This is easier and can give a sight.
